title: Crane Services for Generator Removal
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.419TH CSB.W6QM MICC-FT DRUM
description_text: Crane Services for Generator Removal and Installation Contractor shall provide a 120 ton crane, qualified operator, and certified rigging to remove two existing generators. Offers must conform to the requirements listed in Addendum to FAR 52.212-1. See attached solicitation for more details.
